text: dsh-model-auto-hot-switch 是面向 DSH Web 的模型路由插件，会在每个请求步骤检查消息是否包含图片块，并将识图步骤切换到目录中发现的视觉模型，普通步骤恢复会话默认模型。Web 页面提供浮动开关和状态面板，可查看视觉目标、默认模型及最近切换；开关状态保存在插件目录的 config.json。适合需要在同一会话中处理图片与普通对话、又希望自动选择模型的 DSH 用户。需要已配置可用的视觉模型。

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch routes image steps in DSH Web to a discovered vision model and restores the default model for other tasks. A floating control toggles routing and shows the selected models and latest switch. The setting persists beside the package; a vision-capable model is required.
想让带图片的步骤自动交给支持视觉的模型。
普通对话和识图任务能不能按内容自动切换模型？
Route image requests to a vision model automatically while keeping my default model for other tasks.
dsh-model-auto-hot-switch 的功能「按任务切换模型」：插件检查每步消息是否含图片块，识图步骤使用自动发现的视觉模型，其他步骤恢复会话默认模型。无需手动逐次更换模型。
dsh-model-auto-hot-switch 的功能「Web 开关与状态面板」：点击页面浮动按钮可启用或停用自动热切，并查看视觉模型、默认模型和最近切换记录；设置会保存到插件目录的 config.json。

Zero extra tokens, zero context disturbance, one click to enable.

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · What it does：DeepSeek Harness models do not all accept images. When you ask the agent to read a screenshot, an OCR job, or any image file, the request should go to a vision-capable model — while plain chat and coding keep the fast default model. This plugin makes that switch **automatic and per-task**, inside the same session:

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · What it does：- **Vision task** (the step's messages carry an image) → routed to the discovered vision model, e.g. `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`
- **Everything else** → the exact default model you selected, configuration returned untouched

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · Why it costs nothing：- **Zero extra tokens.** Task classification is pure local code (does the step contain an image block?). No classifier model call, no prompt rewrite, no duplicated requests.
- **No context disturbance.** Only the `provider`/`model` fields of the frozen per-step call configuration are replaced, through the harness's own `agent/request` extension point. Messages, system prompt, tools, and session state are never rewritten.
- **No overhead on normal tasks.** Non-image steps restore the session's default route in one field swap when a previous step left the vision model in the held request header (and return the configuration untouched otherwise) — no classifier call, no extra request.

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · Installation：Requires DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) with a Web profile.

```bash
dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · from npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-model-auto-hot-switch

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · or straight from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:SHUJILAI/dsh-model-auto-hot-switch
```

Restart `dsh web`, then click the floating **⚡** button (bottom-right) to switch automatic hot-switching on. The readout shows:

- the routing target for vision tasks (the first discovered model whose capability declares image input),
- the default model all other tasks keep using,
- the most recent hot-switch event.

The toggle persists in `config.json` beside the package and survives restarts.

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · Prerequisites：- A vision-capable model in your provider catalog. The plugin auto-discovers it through `llm.listModels` / `llm.resolveModelInfo` — no configuration needed. For the official DeepSeek provider this is `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` (available on the DeepSeek API). Without any vision model, the toggle still works but vision routing stays idle and the readout says so.
- The `read_image` tool's own gate must also see the vision model, which requires the dsh build whose DeepSeek adapter declares image input for it.

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · How it works：```
user sends an image task
   │
   ▼
agent/pre-step ──► contains image? ── yes ──► mark this step as vision

The classification runs per `(session, turn, step)` and is consumed by the matching `agent/request` call, so a later step of the same turn re-classifies independently. Subagents get the same treatment under their own sessions.

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · Configuration：None. The single toggle is the whole surface:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `enabled` (in `config.json`) | `true` routes image tasks to the vision model; `false` leaves every request on the default model |

The preferred vision model id is `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`; if absent, the first discovered image-capable model wins.

dsh-model-auto-hot-switch README · Compatibility：- Works with dsh Web profiles (routes under `/plugins/dsh-model-auto-hot-switch/state`).
- Headless profiles: routes are skipped, the hot-switch logic still runs from the persisted toggle.
- Does not depend on any official `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime package; no `peerDependencies`.
